statement: The sibling score cannot be authored from the system coordinate alone: origin and Tidegarden share system -1,-1, while the current generic approach path derives a destination seed from that coordinate and would therefore resolve the origin seed instead of the p1 seed. The destination motif/key must remain silent before legal target selection, then consume the canonical p1 world/profile identity rather than a coordinate-derived approximation.
requestedAction: Freeze in the intent-v1 scene contract that system_body_targeted at anc.crossing.sibling-targeted carries or resolves worldId -1,-1:p1 and passes canonical seed 1600321158 plus profile version/hash and archetype to score; explicitly forbid coordinate-only destination derivation and any Tidegarden motif before that event.

statement: Our independent treatments leave one critical A4 micro-timeline unresolved: Score specifies a 1.75-second post-refusal near-silence and a next-bar audio-scheduled bloom at life-front, while Cinematography specifies 1.5 seconds of absolute stillness and requires physical life/material to be visible before bloom. If these are independently timed, the flagship awakening can either swell before the world changes or reveal visually after its punctuation.
requestedAction: Propose one signed shared sub-anchor rail for anc.a4.life-front: choose one quiet duration, commit alive authority and expose the first physical life sample before any bloom, then place the bloom and emissive/local-light fallback on the exact returned audio time, preferably one rendered frame after first visibility; keep the reduced-sensory envelope on that same timestamp and report the final times/easing for reconciliation.
